description:
Contract locking ether found:
	Contract ZZZNFT (src/ZZZNFT.sol#36-372) has payable functions:
	 - ZZZNFT.mintSeaDrop(address,uint256) (src/ZZZNFT.sol#146-156)
	But does not have a function to withdraw the ether
rationale: The sole payable NFT callback rejects every nonzero msg.value before any bookkeeping. Exact admitted SeaDrop calls it with zero and retains gross ETH for its atomic fee/creator settlement; no normal proceeds enter the NFT. There is deliberately no sweep authority. Forced donations are not a guarantee of recoverable protocol revenue.
review_scope: Individually reassessed current source, exact detector context and SeaDrop callback/lifecycle composition; internal review, not independent approval.

rationale: bytes32 locals initialize to zero. A zero allowlist allocation deliberately has no paid-leaf terms; a positive allocation explicitly assigns the price/fee/cumulative cap and allowlist window hash before use. Thus team-only free proofs do not unnecessarily bind later public pricing. The final hash always includes both tagged term slots; initial root content remains a reviewed manifest obligation.

description:
Reentrancy in ZZZNFT._mintDormant(address,uint256) (src/ZZZNFT.sol#162-194):
	External calls:
	- requestId = IZZZVRFCoordinator(vrf.coordinator).requestRandomWords(IZZZVRFCoordinator.RandomWordsRequest(vrf.keyHash,vrf.subscriptionId,vrf.requestConfirmations,vrf.callbackGasLimit,2,abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(keccak256(bytes)(VRF ExtraArgsV1)),vrf.nativePayment))) (src/ZZZNFT.sol#179-181)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- providerRequestUsed[providerKey] = true (src/ZZZNFT.sol#185)
	- randomness[requestKey].nftId = id (src/ZZZNFT.sol#186)
	- randomness[requestKey].requested = true (src/ZZZNFT.sol#186)
	- requestEpochOf[id] = epoch (src/ZZZNFT.sol#187)
	- requestOf[id] = requestId (src/ZZZNFT.sol#188)
rationale: The provider call sits inside the outer NFT nonReentrant mint/SeaDrop callback. Complete helper supply/wallet/phase counts and NFT ordinal/original recipient are reserved before this call. Request bookkeeping must follow the returned request ID; a synchronous callback sees no armed request and rejects, duplicate/zero provider IDs reject, and the pinned provider/policy/end checks repeat after the ERC721 callback. The new dormant NFT cannot activate before its ordered reveal; independent operations on an already-owned NFT retain the Vault own guards and separated accounting.
review_scope: Individually reassessed current source, exact detector context and SeaDrop callback/lifecycle composition; internal review, not independent approval.

description:
Reentrancy in ZZZNFT.notifyContribution(uint256) (src/ZZZNFT.sol#247-252):
	External calls:
	- royaltyRewards.activate(id,uint256(rarityOf[id]) + 1) (src/ZZZNFT.sol#250)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- MetadataUpdate(id) (src/ZZZNFT.sol#251)
rationale: notifyContribution is usable only by the sealed fixed Vault after successful share issuance. The fixed royalty ledger authenticates the NFT and owns its separate nonReentrant activation accounting; MetadataUpdate is deliberately emitted only after successful royalty activation. This event neither issues shares nor pays funds and failure rolls back the contribution. The new SeaDrop path mints dormant and never calls this activation hook.

description:

The NFT always calls that fixed SeaDrop address with zero value and rechecks authority afterward.
